text: People who have firearms at home are less likely to be killed by a gun than people who do not.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: People who have firearms at home are less likely to be killed by a gun than people who do not have a firearm
room.note: 13% definitely true, 29% probably true, 22% definitely false. KFF offered definitely/probably true and probably/definitely false; the small remainder gave no answer.

truthSource.label: Annals of Internal Medicine (2014 meta-analysis)
truthSource.oneLine: Access to a firearm at home roughly doubles the odds of being a homicide victim and triples the odds of suicide.
